caption:
5 mistakes first-timers make in Bali (save this before you fly).

05 Drinking tap water: stick to bottled or filtered refills
04 Chasing the "best rate": use authorised money changers only
03 Forgetting the levy: IDR 150,000 per person, pay on Love Bali
02 Riding on a car licence: you need a motorbike licence + IDP
01 Booking the wrong area: choose your base by what you came for

Here for cliffs, surf and quiet sunsets? Yume by Nyara is three private-pool villas above Bingin, four minutes from Impossible Beach. Link in bio to book your stay in Bali.

slides.body: Tap water isn't safe to drink. Use bottled or filtered refill water, and order ice from places busy enough to make it fresh.
Skip roadside “best rate” stalls. Use a bank or an authorised money changer showing the Bank Indonesia logo, and count your cash before you leave the counter.
Every foreign visitor pays IDR 150,000 once per trip. Pay on the official Love Bali site and keep the QR voucher handy for arrival.
You need your home motorcycle licence plus an International Driving Permit with the motorbike category. Police run checks in Uluwatu, Canggu and Ubud.

slides.answer: Choose by what you came for.
slides.body: Want cliffs, surf and quiet sunsets? Base yourself on the Bukit, near Bingin and Uluwatu, not in the traffic of the south.
